source.generator: Original Q build bytecode with only new salt/allowed seed cohort; variant transformation after independent public base is built, before prediction. No hidden evidence in predictor.

families.permuted_bits: Apply single independently seeded permutation of all 16 bit coordinates in every public src_bits/dst_bits. Equalities preserved. Length 7/8/9. Exact compatibility oracle.
families.dense_distractors: Add exactly four two-edge public role-matching spur branches, identical to pos/neg graphs, leading from start to preexisting second-hop node with nonmatching continuation key; preserve source token histogram and exact positive=1/negative=0. Length 7/8/9.
families.extended_depth: Append identical three-edge causal chain from former target, using its terminal carried raw key as first new src bit string; three new role labels and nodes. Lengths 10/11/12. Use isolated extended-shape validation adapter for both original models, without editing original source files.
families.one_bit_relaxed_keys: For both pairs, flip the same deterministic one bit of the sixth main-hop incoming src key. New *public* reference relation tolerates <=1 key-bit mismatch per transition; required true positive=1, negative=0 under this alternative rule. Original hard-equality model intentionally expected to generalize poorly. Length 7/8/9.

Wingless.new_architecture: One retained packed 12bit four-channel state per public node, instead of 3 states/node, each channel 0..4 packed into 3 bits. Keep frozen W/Y/Z checksum and existing learned readout weights. On demand edge-bit projection; no global encoded-edge cache, no lookahead result memo, no extra learning. Graph traversal source-only.

Yggdrasil.new_hypothesis: Transfer test of the previously frozen Z public raw-key equality continuity head, penalty EXACTLY 0.5 as FIT selected in original Z; do not re-fit, tune or compare new penalties after viewing DEV.
Yggdrasil.extended_shape_adapter: Only scope structural shape validation to 7..12 hops via a nonmutating function clone of original q/yggdrasil and Z/continuity functions. Verify bitwise parity with immutable original implementations on all <=9 public FIT graphs. No oracle or label may enter model.
Yggdrasil.admission: Exact pairing for permuted/distractor/depth families; <=1-bit relaxed relation only for noise family. Independent reference oracle used solely by scorer.
Yggdrasil.cost: 7 active+9 retained remains fixed; one extra per-cell continuity counter tracked explicitly.
